country.name: Chad
country.jurisdictionNotice: Primary, middle, secondary, technical and vocational, teacher-training and higher education records must remain attached to the competent national and provincial authority.
country.languagePolicy: French and Arabic are official and educationally distinct. National languages and community education require language-, script-, region-, curriculum- and community-specific review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Chadian reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, provincial service, regulator or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The ministry responsible for National Education, Bilingualism and Civic Promotion governs school education; provincial services retain territorial roles; the higher-education ministry governs universities, institutes and professional training within its assigned mandate.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve province, department, commune, official school identity, level, sector, language stream, authorization, operating status and observation year. A statistical yearbook or unverified third-party portal is not current authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution listing, creation, opening authorization, exact program habilitation, diploma authority, quality evaluation and CAMES or professional recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of National Education, Bilingualism and Civic Promotion
authorities.role: school education policy, curricula, administration and examinations

authorities.name: Education planning, analysis and school-map directorate
authorities.role: education census, statistics and school mapping

authorities.name: Provincial education delegations
authorities.role: territorial school administration and current record validation

authorities.name: Competent curriculum and pedagogical inspectorates
authorities.role: approval and implementation oversight for exact programs and materials

authorities.name: Ministry of Higher Education, Scientific Research and Professional Training
authorities.role: higher-education institutions, programs and professional training within its mandate

authorities.name: National examinations and competitive-examinations authority
authorities.role: examination administration and result authority within assigned scope

authorities.name: Competent personal-data protection authority
authorities.role: supervision under the personal-data protection law

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Women and Child Protection

curriculum.authority: Competent national curriculum and pedagogical authority
curriculum.title: Official programs by cycle, class, subject and language stream
curriculum.implementationRule: A ministry webpage announcing program reform, bilingualism or digital resources is not the controlling curriculum. Verify the exact French or Arabic stream, cycle, class, subject, approving order or circular, version and effective school year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Orientation law, program, syllabus, examination framework, approved textbook, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: National education ministry and responsible provincial delegation
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The official 2022–2023 statistical yearbook provides dated system and establishment evidence, but no verified public unified current directory of every public and private school with authorization and operating status was located. Third-party-hosted claims of real-time registration or accreditation must not be treated as official without ministry confirmation.
requiredRecordFields: public, private, community or confessional sector
observation year, source and review date

educationStatistics.authority: Competent education planning directorate and INSEED within their mandates
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The Annuaire Statistique Scolaire 2022–2023 describes that school year even if published or indexed later. Preserve observation year separately from release date, together with cycle, definition, sector, province and denominator.

vocationalQualifications.authority: Higher-education and professional-training ministry and any separately competent technical-education authority
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Provider authorization, exact program approval, occupational standard, examination authority, certificate or diploma authority and professional recognition are separate claims. Verify the current ministry assignment, provider, site, program, language, modality, decision and validity.

higherEducation.authority: Ministry of Higher Education, Scientific Research and Professional Training
higherEducation.authorityNotice: An institution appearing on a ministry page does not prove every program, campus, modality or award is authorized. Verify creation and opening acts, exact program habilitation, diploma authority, site, current status, validity and any CAMES or professional recognition separately.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 007/PR/2015 relating to personal data protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: National Child Protection Policy 2023–2028 and applicable ratified child-rights, criminal, education and social-protection instruments
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Confirm the exact law text, competent supervisory authority, registration or authorization procedures, legal basis, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, retention, security and incidents. A national child-protection policy is not itself a complete statutory code; current education-sector reporting, referral, consent and emergency procedures require review before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French and Arabic streams must remain distinct in curriculum, terminology, assessment and resources. National languages, local scripts, nomadic and displaced-learner contexts and community education require exact locality and community review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Chadian education reviewer is named.
National, provincial, vocational and higher-education responsibilities are verified.
A verified current unified school directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves observation year separately from publication date and scope.
Every curriculum mapping preserves cycle, class, subject, French or Arabic stream, instrument, version and effective year.
Every vocational and higher-education claim separately verifies provider or institution, exact program, decision, award, site, status and validity.
Privacy authority and implementation procedures are verified.
The statutory child framework and education safeguarding pathways are approved before a real learner pilot.
French, Arabic and national-language resources preserve their distinct educational contexts.
